pt.name: Charon
pt.style: Narre em português do Brasil com tom de documentário científico: grave, pausado, reverente, como um narrador de série da BBC. Ritmo calmo, ênfase nos nomes próprios e nas datas.

en.name: Charon
en.style: Narrate in English with a science-documentary tone: deep, measured, reverent, like a BBC series narrator. Calm pacing, emphasis on proper names and dates.

imageStyle: Cinematic dark editorial illustration for a technology history website. Deep obsidian background, volumetric fog, dramatic rim lighting, fine grain, painterly realism, wide 16:9 composition with negative space on the left third. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no UI overlays.

eras.palette: monochrome graphite with warm amber phosphor accents
eras.imagePrompt: A wartime Bletchley Park hut at night: an infinite punched paper tape ribbon curling through the darkness like a river of logic, an electromechanical Bombe rotor cabinet half-lit, brass and bakelite, amber phosphor glow, silhouetted codebreakers.

eras.palette: deep cyanide blue with metallic copper
eras.imagePrompt: The first point-contact transistor on a germanium slab, macro scale, gold foil contacts catching light, surrounded by the ghostly skeleton of a room-sized vacuum-tube computer dissolving into fog behind it. Copper and cyan blue.

Extreme macro of a silicon wafer and an early integrated circuit die, copper interconnect traces radiating like a city grid seen from orbit, wafer rainbow diffraction, a geometric exponential curve implied by receding rows of shrinking chips.

eras.palette: electric purple, magenta and 90s neon gradients
eras.imagePrompt: A beige personal computer glowing in a dark 1990s bedroom, CRT light spilling onto the wall, a globe of fiber-optic network lines rising out of the screen, electric purple and magenta neon gradients, a faint neural network lattice woven through the cables.

eras.palette: electric violet and GPU tensor green
eras.imagePrompt: A dense datacenter aisle at night, racks of GPUs breathing violet light, a vast lattice of tensor matrices floating above the corridor like aurora, cables converging to a vanishing point, cold mist.

An abstract attention mechanism: thousands of luminous cyan filaments connecting floating glass tokens in parallel, no recurrence, a self-attention constellation suspended in obsidian void, glass refraction and caustics.

eras.palette: holographic cyan and quantum green over obsidian
eras.imagePrompt: A dual frontier diptych fused into one image: on one side a dilution refrigerator chandelier of a superconducting quantum processor glowing gold and cyan, on the other an expanding tree of reasoning branches made of light, invalid branches dimming and falling away. Quantum green and holographic cyan.
